content: Capybara with headless Chrome supports viewport resizing via browser.manage.window.resize_to(width, height). This is the method used in the project's features/support/window_resize.rb. The resize must happen before navigation (visit root_path) to ensure the browser's media queries see the new viewport size. The key pitfall: the @mobile_portal tag sets a flag but does NOT resize the browser — ensure_mobile_viewport! must be explicitly called in step definitions. If the resize is not called before visit, Chrome renders at the previous (1280x800) viewport and CSS media queries (max-width: 767px) do not activate.
